title: Brahmanical rock-cut temples at Ellora
summary: Builders excavated the Brahmanical group of temples at Ellora, including the Kailasa temple, between the seventh and tenth centuries. These works sit alongside Buddhist and Jain monuments from other phases.

claims.text: Builders excavated the Brahmanical group of temples at Ellora, including the Kailasa temple, between the seventh and tenth centuries. These works sit alongside Buddhist and Jain monuments from other phases.
Seventh–tenth-century group chronology, not the full site’s dates.

Selecting one documented group avoids compressing the entire site into a misleading single chronology. The ensemble offers a material setting for comparing religious patronage and the technical demands of rock-cut architecture.
